notes:
Summary: Large adtech buyer evaluating Redwood Dedicated for high-throughput real-time inference. Primary ask is firm throughput guarantees and predictable tail latency under heavy bid traffic. Cost-sensitive vs spot/cloud but will accept committed reserve if guarantees hold.

Key throughput asks (negotiation points):
- Minimum sustained throughput: request for contract-level guarantee of 100k tokens/sec sustained across the dedicated pool (across regions) during peak windows.
- Burst allowance: allow bursts up to 400k tokens/sec for up to 45s (3x baseline) with an automated throttling fallback to a lower-cost model variant after burst window.
- Concurrency caps: target concurrency cap 1,200 concurrent inference sessions across the pool, with soft-limit alerts at 80% and hard cap enforcement.
- Per-GPU baseline planning: they want sizing guidance — expect to reserve 8x H100 (80GB) per region initially; request we translate tokens/sec -> GPUs for their model/mix.
- Latency SLOs: 95p token generation latency < 60ms for 1k-token completions; 99p < 220ms. SLA must include credits for repeated 99p breaches.
- Fallback policy: automatic routing to a cheaper model variant (quantized) when reserved pool is at >95% sustained utilization; require explicit failover window and quality regression tolerance.

Security/compliance notes:
- Will need SSO/SAML integration + audit logging for all token-level events.
- Data residency: EU traffic must remain in EU region (ability to pin dedicated capacity to region).

POC / evaluation plan: 3-week POC:
- Week 0 (prep): access control + VPC peering + keys, load generator config.
- Week 1: baseline functional tests (correctness, model parity with hosted).
- Week 2: steady-state sustained throughput tests ramp to 120% of target. Collect tokens/sec, per-GPU utilization, batch sizes, queueing metrics.
- Week 3: burst tests (45s bursts x 10) + canary traffic from production sample. Acceptance: sustained 100k tokens/sec for 30m with 95p latency under targets and no >3% error rate.

Commercial notes:
- Interested in 12–24 month reserved contract with quarterly capacity reviews.
- Asking for a pricing credit in first 3 months if we miss contract throughput on 2+ occasions.

Call quotes / behavior:
- "We can't have unpredictable tails during Black Friday-type windows." — CTO (R. Alvarez).
- AE notes: very technical buyer; wants clear mapping tokens/sec -> GPUs. Prepare model benchmark doc (per-model perf table) and a sample reservation calculator.

Open action items:
- Deliver per-model tokens/sec -> GPU sizing table by 2026-03-12 (assigned SE).
- Legal to propose SLA language with explicit credits for throughput breaches by 2026-03-14.
- Schedule pricing revision meeting 2026-03-15.
